RentalThread
One shared thread for every rental repair from request to payment
A tenant reports a leak on WhatsApp, the plumber emails an estimate, the owner approves on a call, and the receipt ends up in a drawer. We're building one shared thread for every repair, so the tenant, the pro, the owner, and the manager see the same photos, estimate, approval, and payment. Each property also keeps its rent, expenses, and documents in one place. Agents can share one link per listing so people book their own visits. AI turns messages and photos into clear requests and drafts updates, which a person reviews before anything is sent. Available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. We haven't launched yet: join the waitlist for early access and vote for the features you'd use.
Founding offer: first 100 people on waitlist get 30% off their first year

Cullit keeps everything local, runs fast on RAW files, and streamlines metadata, renaming, and batch actions.

OpenSEO
Open-source Ahrefs and SEMrush alternative you can self-host
OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Ahrefs and SEMrush. It is MIT licensed, self-hostable with one Docker command, and has no subscription. You pay per lookup instead of per month, and your data stays on your own infrastructure.
It includes 17 tools: 6 keyword tools (overview, ideas, difficulty, SERP checker), 8 website and backlink tools (domain overview, page analyser, backlink profiles, competitor analysis), and 3 AI and local tools. Site audits run 117 technical checks across up to 500 pages. Local rank grids range from 3x3 to 7x7. OpenSEO also tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity cite your site, measured across 120+ AI models.

Retello
Helping service businesses launch memberships that drive recurring revenue
Retello helps service businesses launch and manage customer memberships. You can build plans with your own services and benefits, customize pricing by vehicle, size, or service, and let customers join through a branded storefront on your website. Collect recurring payments through Stripe, track benefit usage, and check members in from one dashboard. If you already offer memberships, bring your existing plans into Retello to make signing up easier.
